tooltip.arkofcosmos.controls:
<left> to perform a 5-swing combo that ends by throwing the blade
The thrown blade will follow your cursor
Releasing while the blade is out will cause an exploding snap
tooltip.arkofcosmos.parry:
<right> to snip out the scissor blades in front of you
Hitting an enemy with it will parry them, granting you brief invulnerability
You can parry projectiles to make them deal 160 less damage for a short period
Parrying anything will empower the next 16 swings of the sword
tooltip.arkofcosmos.blast:
With empowered charges, hold [%1$s] and press [%2$s] to provoke a Big Rip in spacetime, consuming all charges
If at least 5 charges were consumed, keep holding [%1$s] and [%2$s] until after the snap to dash toward the scissors
tooltip.arkofcosmos.flavor: The physical culmination of your journey, capable of rending gods asunder
